description:
You are a library technician compiling a digital access guide for 'Great American Novels'. Your task is to research four specific classic works across three digital library platforms: Library of Congress (loc.gov), Project Gutenberg (gutenberg.org), and Open Library (openlibrary.org).

The four works are:
1. 'Moby-Dick' by Herman Melville
2. 'Adventures of Huckleberry Finn' by Mark Twain
3. 'The Scarlet Letter' by Nathaniel Hawthorne
4. 'Walden' by Henry David Thoreau

Perform the following actions:
1. Search for each work on all three platforms.
2. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'Collection Development'. Inside it, save at least 8 bookmarks total, ensuring you have links from all three platforms (LOC, Gutenberg, Open Library).
3. Create a structured JSON report file at '~/Documents/bibliographic_report.json'. For each of the four works, record:
   - Title and Author
   - Original Year of Publication
   - Project Gutenberg eBook ID (number)
   - Project Gutenberg URL
   - Open Library URL (Work or Edition link)
   - Library of Congress Catalog URL

The JSON structure should look like this:
{
  "moby_dick": { "title": "...", "author": "...", "year": 1851, "gutenberg_id": 2701, ... },
  "huckleberry_finn": { ... },
  ...
}
